info.title: Lock API
info.description: Manage the realms, clients and identities of this Lock instance.

get.summary: List the clients of a realm

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Available sorts are `name`, `client_id`, `created_at`. You can sort by multiple options by separating them with a comma. To sort in descending order, use `-` sign in front of the sort, for example: `-name`.

parameters.name: filter[name]
parameters.description: Filter by `name`. Matches values containing the given text, case-insensitively. Separate multiple values with a comma; records matching any value qualify.

parameters.name: filter[client_id]
parameters.description: Filter by `client_id`. Matches the exact value. Separate multiple values with a comma; records matching any value qualify.

parameters.name: filter[token_endpoint_auth_method]
parameters.description: Filter by `token_endpoint_auth_method`. Matches the exact value. Separate multiple values with a comma; records matching any value qualify.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: The number of items to retrieve per page.

post.description:
The realm gets its own signing keypair, and its domain is checked right
away. A domain that does not reach this instance yet is reported through
`domain_status` rather than refused — DNS and the proxy usually follow.
Settings left out of `settings` follow the instance defaults.

put.description:
A realm's slug is immutable. Settings left out of `settings` keep
their current value. Re-pointing the domain changes the issuer of every
token the realm mints and restarts the domain check.

delete.description:
Purges the realm's users, roles, clients, tokens and keys, and frees its
slug. The administration realm cannot be deleted.

examples: The administration realm cannot be deleted.

client_id.description: The identifier a relying party authenticates with, and its path in this API.

realm.description: The slug of the realm the client belongs to.

name.description: Human readable name, shown to the identity on the consent screen.

token_endpoint_auth_method.description: How the client authenticates at the token endpoint.

confidential.description: Whether the client holds a secret.

grant_types.description: The grants the client may use.

redirect_uris.description: Where an authorization response may be sent back to.

post_logout_redirect_uris.description: Where an end-session request may return to.

consent_required.description: Whether the identity is asked to consent before the client is granted its scopes.

backchannel_logout_uri.description: Where a back-channel logout token is delivered.

scopes.description: The scopes the client is granted, from the realm’s client policy.

revoked.description: Whether the client is blocked from obtaining tokens.

revoked_at.description: When the client was blocked, if it is.

updated_at.description: When the client was last changed.

client_id.description: The identifier a relying party authenticates with.

secret.description: The credential disclosed by this explicit write-scoped operation; null for a public client.

name.description: Human readable name, shown to the identity on the consent screen.

token_endpoint_auth_method.description: How the client authenticates at the token endpoint. `none` makes it a public client with no secret.

grant_types.description: The grants the client may use.

redirect_uris.description: Where an authorization response may be sent back to. Required for the authorization code grant.

post_logout_redirect_uris.description: Where an end-session request may return to.

consent_required.description: Whether the identity is asked to consent before the client is granted its scopes.

backchannel_logout_uri.description: Where a back-channel logout token is delivered.

name.description: Human readable name shown to the realm’s users.

slug.description: Stable identifier, lowercase and dash separated. It cannot be changed later.

domain.description: The domain the realm is served from. Lock checks that it reaches this instance, but keeps the realm either way.

settings.description: The realm’s policy. Settings left out follow the instance defaults.

identifier.description: A path relative to the realm issuer, or an absolute URI with a host and no fragment.

name.description: Human readable name of the protected resource.

scopes.description: Scopes to create with this resource.

value.description: Scope value, unique within its resource. Whitespace is not allowed.

description.description: Human readable description of the scope. Null clears the description.

key.description: Immutable provider key used in callback URLs and linked accounts.

config.description: Credentials required by the selected driver.

enabled.description: Whether the realm accepts sign-ins through this provider.

credentials.description: The credentials issued at creation. Regular client reads never contain them.

slug.description: Stable identifier of the realm, and its path in this API.

name.description: Human readable name shown to its users.

host.description: The host the realm is served from.

issuer.description: The realm’s OIDC issuer, the `iss` of every token it mints.

domain.description: The configured domain; null for the master realm, which follows APP_URL.

domain_status.description: Whether the configured domain was seen to reach this instance.

domain_checked_at.description: When the domain was last checked.

domain_check_error.description: Why the last domain check failed, when it did.

master.description: Whether this is the administration realm, which cannot be deleted or re-pointed.

updated_at.description: When the realm was last changed.

RealmDomainStatus.description: What the last domain check found. `Unreachable` means no HTTP answer at all (DNS, connection, TLS); `Misrouted` means something answered, but not this Lock instance.
RealmDomainStatus.title: RealmDomainStatus

access_token_lifetime.description: Seconds an access token stays valid.

id_token_lifetime.description: Seconds an ID token stays valid.

dynamic_registration.description: Whether a client may register itself through RFC 7591.

client_id.description: Client ID required by every driver.

team_id.description: Team ID required by the Apple driver.

key_id.description: Key ID required by the Apple driver.

private_key.description: Write-only private key for Apple. Required on creation; blank or null keeps the stored key on update.

id.description: Provider UUID used in API paths.

key.description: Immutable provider key used for social login and linked accounts.

enabled.description: Whether sign-ins through this provider are enabled.

config.description: Public configuration only. Client secrets and private keys are never returned.

callback_url.description: Callback URL to register with the upstream provider.

updated_at.description: When the provider was last changed.

SocialProviderDriver.description: The brokering drivers use-lock/server's SocialProviderRegistry ships. Each one needs a different set of credentials, which is why the stored config is a map rather than columns.
SocialProviderDriver.title: SocialProviderDriver

TokenEndpointAuthMethod.description: RFC 7591 §2 / OIDC Registration §2: how a client authenticates at the token, introspection and revocation endpoints. Enforced exactly: a client registered for one method is refused when it presents another.
TokenEndpointAuthMethod.title: TokenEndpointAuthMethod

name.description: Human readable name, shown to the identity on the consent screen.

token_endpoint_auth_method.description: How the client authenticates at the token endpoint. Turning a public client confidential mints a secret; the other way around drops it.

grant_types.description: The grants the client may use. Replaces the current set.

redirect_uris.description: Where an authorization response may be sent back to. Replaces the current list.

post_logout_redirect_uris.description: Where an end-session request may return to. Replaces the current list.

consent_required.description: Whether the identity is asked to consent before the client is granted its scopes.

backchannel_logout_uri.description: Where a back-channel logout token is delivered; `null` clears it.

name.description: Human readable name shown to the realm’s users.

domain.description: The domain the realm is served from. Re-pointing it changes the issuer and restarts the domain check.

settings.description: Any subset of the realm’s policy; settings left out keep their current value.

identifier.description: A path relative to the realm issuer, or an absolute URI with a host and no fragment.

name.description: Human readable name of the protected resource.

scopes.description: Scope changes keyed by value: new values create, existing values update, delete: true removes. Omitted entries remain unchanged; an empty array changes nothing.

config.description: Credentials to replace. Omitted values and blank secrets keep their stored value.

enabled.description: Whether the realm accepts sign-ins through this provider.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
